marketing.description: Syphon Filter (1999) statically recompiled to native code on psxrecomp, with native widescreen (16:9, 21:9, adaptive), a HUD anchored to the wide edges and an in-game menu. Source only: bring your own disc.

warnings: cue has only 1 TRACK — Track-01-only dumps fail multi-track netplay/catalog gates; prefer a full Redump cue.
notes: seeds are first-pass boot-EXE JAL targets (+ entry); expect to grow as overlays / runtime paths are discovered.
